en: Ring... ring...
Huhh?
Hello?
Fiena? Can you talk right now?
...Hic.
Who is thiiis?
Fiena, it's me. Sil.
Abigail and I are coming to your flower garden...
Try to get ready for the tea party.
Awwgh...
Get bread ready? In the oven? What bread?
No, I said we're coming to prepare for the tea party!
So get yourself ready...
Got it! Get the bread in the oven and... uh...
......Who is thiiis?
Never mind. See you later.
Ring... ring...
Hello? Fiena?
Oh, hello? Sil!
It's about the last tea party.
Mhm~ What about it?
You said you couldn't remember anything from when you were free of the mixture's influence.
I wondered whether you truly remember nothing.
I feel like I remember... and also like I don'too...
I dunno~ Nahaha!
I see... I guess it can't be helped.
But something feels strange~
What is?
Ever since the last tea party~
Chloe and Abigail have been acting kind of awkward around me.
Sil~ Did I mess up again?
Uuugh... Now I'm suddenly so sad~!
Sniff, sniff...
There, there.
You didn't do anything too terrible, so don't worry.
Except for throwing up in front of Nahatra...
Really? Then that's a relief~
Then make sure you sober up a little before the tea party.
Mhm~ Got it~!
Hello?
Oho, nufufufu!! ...Hic!
...Fiena?
Gulp... gulp...
Pwaaah~!
This is great~ So good~ Right, Sil~?
You're a complete drunk.
A drunk~? Oho, hehehe...! Well, that's true~
Buurp... Ah, excuse me. Nahahaha!
I just called because I feel sooo good~! Ohoho!
Yeah, I can tell.
How much did you drink?
Looks like I drank quite a lot~
I'm starting to see it now~
See what?
Well, that's~ Ohoho, nufufufu!!
I wish you could see it too, Sil... Hic!
The more I drink, the more clearly I see it... the shape of the garden...
Gulp, gulp... Pwaaah~!
Fiena, I think you should stop now...
A toast! To the singing stars...!
Urk, ugh...!
...Bleeergh.
Good grief.
Phew~ I feel a little better...
That's what happens when you drink too much.
...Oh, Sil?
And... where did everyone go?
What went where?
...Good question! Nahahaha!
Ugh, my head...!
Get some rest until the tea party.
And don't drink more just because you're thirsty.
Yeah, yeah. Got it.
Ring... ring...
Hello?
Oh, it's you, Sil...
I called because I was wondering about something.
Do other witches often come and go at your club?
Why ask that all of a sudden...?
Let's just say I was curious.
Well, it's not like I can't answer.
Well, Fiena sometimes drops by with drinks.
Whenever she shows up, it turns into a party.
S-seriously, they're all party animals...
Oh, Chloe visits once in a great while too.
To lecture us.
As if she forgets whose realm this is...
Sil? Are you listening?
I see. Hmm...
So Abigail really has never visited...
Huh? What did you just say...?
Nothing. That was very helpful.
See you at the tea party.
Ring... ring...
Hello?
Huff, huff...
My, miss, you have such a healthy color...
If you have time for that nonsense, go prepare for the tea party, Rims.
Hehe... I wonder how long you can keep that attitude.
I heard everything. Your secret...
My secret?
I don't really have any secrets.
Oh... really?
Like sobbing after reading a novel...
Or copying the heroine's outfit and striking poses...
Those aren't secrets...?
What...?!
How do you know that...?!
Hehehe... There are countless ways to uncover a secret...
All kinds of guests come to the club...
If I wanted, I could even find out what you say in your sleep.
Ah... Canele! That little...!
Don't worry, Sil! I'll tell you how to keep your secret.
You simply have to quench my thirst...
Ghk...
I won't fall for that trick.
Oh... So this isn't enough.
Let's see how long you can hold out...
Ring... ring...
Hello?
Ah, Sil...
Have you finally decided to offer your blood and flesh?
Of course not.
Do you know the recipe for Fiena's mixture?
What...? The mixture's recipe...?
W-why are you asking me...?
Because Fiena said she didn't know...
I-if she doesn't know how, how does she usually make it?
She says she doesn't really know that either...
Apparently it just appears while she dances and sings.
I-I see...
But what are you going to do with the recipe?
Ah...! You're preparing for when Fiena wakes from the mixture's influence.
That's part of it, but...
I think we'd be in trouble if Fiena truly forgot how to make it.
We'd lose one of the ingredients for the tea party.
A-anyway, I don't know the recipe either.
Why not ask Chloe?
She's obsessed with collecting things, so she may have written it down...
I don't want to call Chloe...
I feel like she'll lecture me again.
Yeah... that won't be easy...
It'll probably be fine. If it truly becomes a problem, I'll deal with it then.
Hello?
...Who is it?
It's me, Sil.
Tch...
Isn't that a bit cruel?
Just tell me what you want.
I heard Abigail is in charge of gathering the witches this time.
So, is that really how it's going?
Yeah. It is.
And thanks to that, my door got smashed.
Huh? What do you mean?
Sigh... It's not important.
Hmm...
Anyway, what do you think?
Do you think Abigail will come to our club too?
I'm not telling you anything.
Isn't that mean? It would be her historic first visit...
We need to make a strong first impression so she'll become a regular.
Your first impression is already strong enough, so please don't do anything.
Hmm... So you won't tell me anything?
Fine. See you later, Sil♡
Ring... ring...
Hellooo~?
Berry, I called because I have a question.
You never call unless you want to ask something.
Isn't that awful? I feel like bursting into tears right now.
Then go ahead and cry.
So, what do you want to know?
About when Fiena was sober... or rather, when she became strange.
You mean Fiena with the mixture's effects completely gone.
That wasn't the first time you'd seen her like that, right?
You looked like you already knew about it.
Right. The first time was probably... when Fiena came to visit the club.
At first, I thought she was just throwing up all over the floor as usual...
Then she collapsed and didn't move for days.
And when she finally woke up...
She was normal again.
Well, it didn't last long then either.
It was entertaining to watch, though.
Hmm...
Maybe if she keeps throwing up, the real Fiena buried deep inside will emerge?
Who knows? Would we even recognize the real Fiena?
That's... true.
Who is this?
Who else? Your precious, adorable witch neighbor♡
Aren't we a little too far apart to be neighbors?
Just get to the point.
Actually, I have a favor to ask.
Would you make me an outfit for going out?
New clothes? What for?
What do you mean, what for?
For me, obviously!
Annoying, but I can't argue with that.
It'd be nice to dress up for the tea party, wouldn't it?
While we're at it, let's make you a new outfit too!
How long are you going to keep walking around in those dusty clothes?
Refrain from rude remarks.
Besides, this outfit is...
Yes, yes. Durable, sensitive to magic, and all that, right?
Don't you ever get tired of it? At this point, I should choose your clothes myself.
Oh? Now that I say it, that sounds like a great idea!
It's not a good idea at all.
Next time you come over, I'll have a uniform ready for you♡
I'm never wearing it.
Ring... ring...
Hello?
Hello, Chloe?
I'm looking for a book, so I called.
What kind? Pharmacology? Or sorcery?
No. A woodworking book. I need to put a new door on my house.
Abigail blew the front door off. Haha.
What?
Sil, I think this every time...
You're far too lenient with Abigail.
She still doesn't understand a lot of things.
She punches people less often than before, too.
Even if Abigail is attached to you, there are limits.
Sometimes you have to be strict.
Being strict will only make her rebel.
What if she turns into a spoiled witch?
There's no guarantee that will happen.
Why can't you trust Abigail and wait?
This isn't about trust. It's about a witch's innate instincts.
A witch's instincts are dangerous. If they aren't guided properly, they can cause disaster.
We have to teach her strictly so she can control that nature herself.
You haven't cured your own addiction to print either!
It's not that I can't fix it...!
Sigh...
...Enough. The tea party is almost here; we don't have time for this.
Right. Let's leave this conversation for later.
So, about that woodworking book...
Hmph.
Click!
Beep... beep...
Huh.
Ring... ring...
Who is it?
Um, Chloe...
Sil?
Are you calling about the tea party?
Yes, of course...
There's something I need for the tea party.
What?
I need "that stuff" the spiders produce...
That soft, silky stuff...
...Be honest, Sil.
Spider silk has nothing to do with the tea party.
But the silk your spiders produce is top quality!
I could weave a tablecloth with it... um...
Anyway, it's amazing stuff!
Calm down, Sil.
We can't waste power on something unrelated to the ritual...
Can't you make an exception?
I'm asking you so nicely...
Ghk...
No means no!
Just prepare for the tea party.
Ghk...
Tch... fine...
...I never should have shown her the silk.
Ring... ring...
Chloe, it's me.
Ah, Sil. I was waiting for you.
You already know why I told you to call.
Yeah.
Because I came into contact with Nahatra as she was waking...
You want to know whether it left any effects on me, right?
Right.
And I also want to study dreams and nightmares.
I always tell you, not a single thread of my body is out of place.
Brushing against a nightmare isn't enough to faze me.
Whether there is a problem or not, recording it is important.
Let's begin with the first item.
Have you noticed any sensory abnormalities since the nightmare affected you?
No. And the answer to every question after that is also "no".
I'm really fine, so let's make this quick this time.
Still, I can't ignore procedure...
But your questions are far too detailed and too long.
Hmm... So the format itself is the problem.
It can't be helped...
Phew...
Maybe it would be better to bring you to my study and examine you directly...
Huh?
To examine you from head to toe, I'll need a large quantity of reagents.
Yes, I'll create hundreds of test items... and if I use a magic circle...
A little pain would improve efficiency...
Um...
I-I'll hang up now...?
Click!
Beep... beep...
I should stay away from Chloe's realm for a while.
Ring... ring...
Hello, Fiena?
Oh, Sil~!
What's up?
I was wondering whether you got an invitation too.
An invitation?
Yeah. A suspicious invitation from Berry...
An invitation~? I didn't get one.
I didn't get oooone~! Waaah!!
Why are you crying again?
You're going to leave me out and have fun without me, aren't you...?
Do you hate me because I'm always drunk?
No, that's not it...
You really do hate me, don't you...?
Waaah, waaah!
Here we go again.
Don't cry. Come on, stop crying!
We can all have fun at the tea party, right?
Mhm...
Then you just need to prepare properly for the tea party, okay?
Mhm...
When you see everyone at the tea party, you'll feel better. Right?
Yeah~ That sounds good!
Phew... All right, all right.
See you then, Sil~
Hello?
Sil~!
I'm glad I reached you~ Are you feeling better now? Nufufu!
I was really worried. Are you all right~?
Huh? You were worried about me...?
What are you talking about all of a sudden?
Oh, don't you remember, Sil~?
You said you wondered what the mixture tasted like~
At first you said you'd only have a tiny taste...
But in the end... Nahaha!
A few days ago...?
You must be mistaken. I don't remember anything like that.
Well, well well well~! Nufufufufu...!!
You truly don't remember~?
You got drunk and... all sorts of things happened~ Ohohoho!
I-I really don't know what you're talking about.
Don't worry, Sil~
I'll keep what happened that day a secret forever~
O-okay...
I have no idea what you mean, but thanks.
Just remember that it was a lot of fun~ Nufufu!
Click!
Beep... beep...
I was drunk? That can't be...
Though my memories from a few days ago do seem a little hazy... ugh...
Sil~
Oh, Fiena.
What's up? Is it about the tea party?
No~. My shoes and my staff and~
I was wondering if my clothes and things were left at your house~
What...?
You scattered your belongings everywhere again.
I-it's not exactly like thaaat...
Ehehe...
Just take your time and remember where you went.
Did you go to the farm or the club? Were you alone?
Actually, I don't remember very well...
I do remember dancing and singing with Nahatra.
With Nahatra?
Mhm~!
We climbed so, so high...
In the pouring starlight...♩
Hmm-hmm... ♪ Hmm... ♫
There she goes drifting away again.
Snap out of it, Fiena!
Ow, my ears!
What now?
What a relief~ Everything was under the bed~
I wonder who arranged everything so neatly?
That was probably you...
Nahahaha!! Looks like it~!!
Anyway, thanks for helping me, Sil!!
Ring... ring...
Who is it?
It's me, Chloe.
Hmm... What is it?
The last tea party was a complete mess.
So... I just thought I'd call.
Sigh, Sil...
I don't want an apology from anyone.
Though I doubt that's why you called.
I've already made my position clear. Keep that in mind.
But you'll change your mind eventually.
...Are you wondering whether my flames can reach you from here?
Sorry! Pretend you didn't hear that.
So... you have no intention of taking back what you declared at the last tea party?
That's right.
Okay.
Oh, and one more thing. Did you get an invitation too?
An invitation?
I got a strange letter from Berry.
It was an invitation to the tea party.
Who knows. Even if one was sent, it probably wouldn't reach me.
My servant would deem it an impurity and burn it.
Well, it is rather impure...
Don't let an invitation distract you. Focus on what you need to do. Understood?
Ring... ring...
What is it?
Ah, Chloe...?!
...Why are you surprised when you're the one who called?
Well, I didn't think you'd still answer my calls.
...Are you testing my patience?
Oh, no, that's not it... haha.
Sil, I don't have time for this right now.
Before the garden's end arrives...
I have mountains of records to organize.
You're organizing records even now...?
You all live doing whatever you want, don't you?
I'm simply doing what I want to do.
I'm curious what could still need so much work.
Mostly old records of the garden.
Many parts are missing, so there is a lot to reconstruct.
For example, records from shortly after the tea party began.
Oh, those days.
The witches are a mess even now, but back then they were worse.
Your actions are recorded too. "The Thread Witch suddenly..."
Wait! We agreed not to talk about what happened back then.
Can't you leave the details blank?
Heh... No, I can't.
There's too much to learn from it to throw it away.
Really? That's a little embarrassing...
I'm preserving it so others know what not to imitate!
Sorry. I knew that; I just wanted to say it.
If you know, then behave properly in the first place.
Hmph!
